entries.en: Something is keeping Mogga from crossing this bridge.
entries.fr: Mogga a l'air un peu inquiet.
entries.ja: 白亜の宮殿のモグッカは、少し怯えているようだ。

entries.en: Mogga has been tasked with patrolling Zenith for any signs of dragons serving the evil Nidhogg, and it seems she may have found some across the bridge she is cowering in front of. However, the poor moogle is too frightened to check herself, and bids you go in her stead. Cross the bridge and be on the lookout for any dragons that may be lurking about.
entries.fr: Mogga a eu un mauvais pres<->sen<->ti<->ment et vous a demandé d'aller terminer sa ronde à sa place.
entries.ja: 宮殿内が制圧されたことを、「モグモグ護衛団」のモグッカに伝えた。モグッカは、冒険者に見回りを代わってほしいようだ。ドラヴァニア雲海の白亜の宮殿を見回り、敵が現れたら討伐しよう。
entries.frMacro: Mogga a eu un mauvais pres<->sen<->ti<->ment et vous a demandé d'aller terminer sa ronde à sa place.

entries.en: You have rid this part of Zenith of the dragon threat...for now. Report to Mogga and tell her the hardest part of her patrol is finished.
entries.fr: Il y avait bel et bien des disciples de Nidhogg à l'endroit où Mogga devait faire sa ronde, mais vous les avez éliminés. Allez annoncer au pauvre Mog que sa mission est remplie et qu'il n'a plus rien à craindre.
entries.ja: 現れた敵を討伐した。白亜の宮殿の「モグッカ」に報告しよう。

entries.en: Relieved that she will no longer have to deal with the wrath of dragons, Mogga returns to her patrol duty and asks you to warn Mogok to be extra alert on his patrol.
entries.fr: Mogga est parti se cacher devant le palais de Zénith en attendant que vous vous y retrouviez tous. Il ne vous reste plus qu'à aller prévenir Mogok.
entries.ja: モグッカは引き続き、宮殿内の見回りを続けるようだ。モグッカは、護衛団の仲間であるモグオクのことが気がかりなようだ。白亜の宮殿付近で「モグオク」を見かけたら、注意するよう伝えてあげよう。

entries.en: Search for dragons in the specified areas.
entries.ja: 白亜の宮殿を見回り、敵が現れたら討伐

entries.en: Oh! Adventurer, I thought you were a dragon, kupo!
entries.fr: Kuppo<nbsp>! Vous m'avez fait peur<nbsp>! J'étais perdu dans mes pensées...
entries.ja:
……くぽっ！
なんだ冒険者か、びっくりしたくぽ～。
entries.frMacro: Kuppo<nbsp>! Vous m'avez fait peur<nbsp>! J'étais perdu dans mes pensées...
entries.jaMacro:
……くぽっ！
なんだ冒険者か、びっくりしたくぽ～。

entries.en: What!? Dragons have already been spotted prowling Zenith? We can't just let them run amok in our sacred palaces!
entries.fr: Kuppopo<nbsp>!? Des disciples de Nidhogg ont pénétré dans l'enceinte de Zénith<nbsp>!? Mais c'est affreux, kuppo<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
くぽぽっ！？
もう宮殿の内部に、邪竜様の眷属が侵入しているくぽ？
そ、それは大変くぽ～！

もう宮殿の内部に、邪竜様の眷属が侵入しているくぽ？
そ、それは大変くぽ～！
entries.speaker: MOGGA

entries.en: In fact, I think I can hear their impudent growls from here. But...dragons are so monstrous, and their claws are so sharp...
entries.fr: Je devais aller faire ma ronde là-haut, mais j'ai eu un mauvais pres<->sen<->ti<->ment, kuppo. Si ça se trouve...
entries.ja:
じ、じゃあ、この先にも、もしかして……くぽ？
なんだか気味が悪くなってきたくぽ……。

entries.en: Just imagining the dragons fills me with dread...but <italic(1)>you're<italic(0)> brave enough! Do you suppose maybe you could cross this bridge and scare away any dragons you find, kupo?
entries.macro: Just imagining the dragons fills me with dread...but <italic(1)>you're<italic(0)> brave enough! Do you suppose maybe you could cross this bridge and scare away any dragons you find, kupo?
entries.fr: Brrr<nbsp>! J'en ai froid dans le dos, kuppo<nbsp>! Vous ne voulez pas aller voir à ma place<nbsp>?
entries.ja:
口に出して言ってみたら、ちょっと怖くなってきたくぽ……。
この先の様子、ちょっと見てきてくれないくぽ？

entries.en: I can't imagine there're very many of them... Just cross the bridge and check, will you?

entries.en: There...there were <italic(1)>how<italic(0)> many dragons across the bridge? Thank heavens for you, adventurer, I would've tired out after slaying just one, kupo.

entries.fr: Il y avait vraiment des disciples de Nidhogg là-haut<nbsp>!? Alors, j'avais vu juste, kuppo<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ほ、ほんとうに邪竜様の眷属がいたくぽ！？
くぽぽ、モグの予想は的中くぽ！

entries.en: Well, I shall return to my patrol... Mayhap I should keep a wide berth from <italic(1)>this<italic(0)> area...

entries.fr: Si j'y étais allé moi-même, je me serais fait battre à plate couture, kuppo... Bon, je vous laisse aller prévenir Mogok.
entries.ja:
モグだったら、やられてたくぽ……ありがとうくぽ！
じゃあ、モグは気をつけながら見回りをしてくるくぽ～。

entries.en: Ah, while you're here, I would ask one more favor from you. Mogok is also patrolling the area nearby. Pray tell him to be <italic(1)>extra<italic(0)> alert on his patrol─we wouldn't want him to be dragon food, kupo!
